description: List the hosts in one of the organization's private fleets (dedicated machines Edgegap manages for you), with status, IP and location. Only ACTIVE hosts accept deployments. Pass their host_id values to edgegap_deploy as private_host_ids to place a server on them first. Organizations without private fleets get an error from the API.

fleet_name.description: The private fleet name, as shown in the dashboard.

name: edgegap_list_fleet_hosts
title: List the hosts of a private fleet
